name: SWECC Labs Landing Page
description: This very repo accepts contributions! Help make SWECC Labs better by contributing to our website and documentation.

name: SWECC Website
description: Contribute to the growth of the SWECC website and help us build a better online experience.

name: SWECC Engagement
description: A React single-page app template with built-in user authentication, layout, and routing. The foundation for SWECC's engagement tooling and a great starting point for building full SPAs.

name: SWECC Interview
description: A React-based interview preparation app. Practice and track technical interview skills with a clean Chakra UI interface backed by Supabase.

name: SWECC Course Scraper
description: A tool to scrape a certain website's API for personal usage. Users can gather course metadata and prerequisites to be used programmatically elsewhere.

name: SWECC OSS Explorer
description: A searchable browser for open issues across the ~100 most active open-source projects on GitHub, available as a Python CLI and a zero-build web app. Every search hits the GitHub API live — nothing is ever stored.
